# Mirai.css Component Library Guide for LLMs

Mirai.css is a component library that automatically styles native HTML elements into modern, themed components.
It provides utility classes for theming, sizing, and variants while integrating with Tailwind CSS.

## CRITICAL SETUP REQUIREMENTS

### Required CDN Imports (EXACT ORDER MATTERS):

```html
<!-- 1. Tailwind CSS MUST come first -->
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@tailwindcss/browser@4"></script>

<!-- 2. Mirai.css MUST come after Tailwind for proper CSS cascade -->
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://esm.sh/gh/aipx-proto/mirai-css@main/styles/mirai.build.css?raw" />
```

**NEVER** reverse this order or styling will break.

## STRICT USAGE RULES

### DO:

- Use semantic HTML elements (button, input, select, etc.)
- Use Tailwind classes for layout, spacing, typography, and positioning
- Use Mirai.css classes for component appearance and behavior
- Write only HTML with utility classes
- Use dark theme by default (bg-neutral-700, bg-neutral-800, bg-neutral-900)
- Use neutral colors (white, neutral-200, neutral-400 for text; neutral-600, neutral-900 for borders)

### NEVER DO:

- **NEVER** Write CSS in `<style>` tags
- **NEVER** Write CSS in `.css` files
- **NEVER** Use `style=""` attributes
- **NEVER** Apply Tailwind classes to table elements (table, thead, tr, td, th, tbody)
- **NEVER** Style elements that Mirai.css already handles (buttons, inputs, etc.)
- **NEVER** Use Tailwind CSS inside `<style>` tags (it won't work)

## COLOR SCHEME GUIDELINES

Mirai.css is dark theme by default.

**Backgrounds:**

- Primary: `bg-neutral-700` - panel and card background
- Secondary: `bg-neutral-800` - control background
- Deepest: `bg-neutral-900` - page background

**Text:**

- Primary: `text-white` - headings
- Secondary: `text-neutral-200` - body
- Muted: `text-neutral-400`

**Borders:**

- Prominent: `border-neutral-600` - border around cards
- Subtle: `border-neutral-900` - border between panels

## COMPONENT PATTERNS

### Buttons

```html
<!-- Primary button (brand-colored, most prominent) -->
<button class="mri-appearance-primary">Primary Action</button>

<!-- Default button (outlined, secondary) -->
<button>Default Button</button>

<!-- Subtle button (dark background, minimal) -->
<button class="mri-appearance-subtle">Subtle</button>

<!-- Transparent button (no background) -->
<button class="mri-appearance-transparent">Transparent</button>

<!-- Icon-only button (square aspect ratio) -->
<button class="mri-icon-only"><vibe-icon name="dismiss">X</vibe-icon></button>

<!-- Button-styled elements -->
<input type="submit" value="Submit" />
<input type="reset" value="Reset" />
<a href="#" class="mri-button">Link Button</a>
<select class="mri-button">
  <option>Option 1</option>
</select>
```

### Inputs

```html
<!-- Default input (subtle appearance) -->
<input type="text" placeholder="Enter text" />

<!-- Outlined input -->
<input type="text" placeholder="Outlined input" class="mri-appearance-outline" />

<!-- Input with embedded content (search, buttons, icons) -->
<div class="mri-input">
  <vibe-icon name="search">🔍</vibe-icon>
  <input type="text" placeholder="Search..." />
  <button class="mri-size-small">Go</button>
</div>

<!-- Form inputs -->
<input type="email" placeholder="Email" />
<input type="password" placeholder="Password" />
<textarea placeholder="Message"></textarea>
```

### Form Controls

```html
<!-- Checkbox (default) -->
<label><input type="checkbox" /> Remember me</label>

<!-- Switch variant -->
<label><input type="checkbox" class="mri-switch" /> Enable notifications</label>

<!-- Radio buttons -->
<label><input type="radio" name="option" value="1" /> Option 1</label>
<label><input type="radio" name="option" value="2" /> Option 2</label>

<!-- Range slider -->
<input type="range" min="0" max="100" value="50" />
```

### Progress Indicators

```html
<!-- Determinate progress bar -->
<progress value="33" max="100"></progress>

<!-- Indeterminate progress bar (pulsing) -->
<progress indeterminate></progress>

<!-- Spinner (circular loading indicator) -->
<progress class="mri-spinner" indeterminate></progress>
```

### Accordions

```html
<!-- Accordion using native details/summary -->
<details>
  <summary>Accordion Title</summary>
  <div class="p-4">
    <p>Accordion content goes here.</p>
  </div>
</details>
```

### Tabs

```html
<!-- Horizontal tabs -->
<nav class="mri-tab-list">
  <button class="mri-tab mri-active">Active Tab</button>
  <button class="mri-tab">Tab 2</button>
  <button class="mri-tab">Tab 3</button>
</nav>

<!-- Vertical tabs -->
<nav class="mri-tab-list mri-vertical">
  <a href="#section1" class="mri-tab mri-active">Section 1</a>
  <a href="#section2" class="mri-tab">Section 2</a>
  <a href="#section3" class="mri-tab">Section 3</a>
</nav>
```

### Dialogs

```html
<!-- Native dialog element -->
<dialog>
  <div class="p-6">
    <h2 class="text-xl font-semibold mb-4">Dialog Title</h2>
    <p class="mb-4">Dialog content goes here.</p>
    <div class="flex gap-2 justify-end">
      <button class="mri-appearance-transparent">Cancel</button>
      <button class="mri-appearance-primary">Confirm</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</dialog>
```

## SIZING CLASSES

```html
<!-- Small size -->
<button class="mri-size-small">Small</button>

<!-- Default size -->
<button>Default</button>

<!-- Large size -->
<button class="mri-size-large">Large</button>
```

## ICONS

Use the vibe-icon web component 

## LAYOUT WITH TAILWIND

Combine Mirai.css components with Tailwind layout utilities:

```html
<div class="bg-neutral-700 p-6 rounded-2xl max-w-sm flex flex-col gap-4">
  <h2 class="text-2xl font-semibold text-white">Sign In</h2>
  <p class="text-neutral-400">Sign in to your account</p>
  <div class="flex flex-col gap-1">
    <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-neutral-200">Email</label>
    <input type="email" placeholder="name@example.com" />
  </div>
  <div class="flex flex-col gap-1">
    <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-neutral-200">Password</label>
    <input type="password" placeholder="********" />
  </div>
  <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
    <input type="checkbox" id="remember" />
    <label for="remember" class="text-sm text-neutral-200">Remember me</label>
  </div>
  <div class="flex gap-2">
    <button class="mri-appearance-primary flex-1">Sign In</button>
    <button class="flex-1">Sign Up</button>
  </div>
</div>
```
